abstract: We show that the intraband thermo-optical response to ultrashort intense infra-red illumination of transparent conducting oxides is much stronger than the nonlinear response associated with resonant and non-resonant interband transitions in typical experimental setups. This finding rules out several speculative explanations of recent measurements.
